text: Over the last 30 days, some visitors have expressed frustration with the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, feeling it detracts from the educational value and does not adequately convey Theodore Roosevelt’s historical significance. A few reviews noted issues with overcrowding, especially during school group visits, which limited access to certain exhibits. There were also comments about the lack of a clear introductory film and insufficient depth in the presentation of Roosevelt’s accomplishments. On the positive side, many visitors appreciated the interactive exhibits and the building’s architecture, contributing to the overall high average rating. Attention to balancing technology with substantive content and managing crowd flow could improve the visitor experience.

windows.7: Over the past week, visitors have generally given very positive feedback, with no critical reviews among the 23 submitted. However, some comments raised concerns about the use of AI in the exhibits, suggesting this aspect may need further review or adjustment. The interactive exhibits received the most attention, with many visitors engaging with them, while a few noted issues related to interpretation and historical balance. There were also occasional remarks about the architecture and the amount of time spent in the library. Food and beverage options, as well as timed entry and staff interactions, were mentioned infrequently.

windows.60: Over the last 60 days, some visitors have raised concerns about crowding, especially when large groups of schoolchildren arrive simultaneously, which limits access to exhibits. Several critical reviews focused on the heavy use of AI in the exhibits, with some feeling it detracts from the educational value and does not adequately convey Theodore Roosevelt’s historical significance. A few visitors also noted the lack of a clear introductory film or deeper historical context about Roosevelt’s accomplishments. Other issues mentioned include timed entry procedures and parking. Some visitors found the exhibits did not provide enough detailed information about Theodore Roosevelt’s accomplishments and impact. There were also comments about physical accessibility issues with certain kiosks. Positive remarks were made about the architecture and interactive exhibits overall, but interpretation and educational content could be improved.
